prompt: Your system prompt begins with "Current time: <timestamp>", followed by 10k tokens of stable instructions, and the cache breakpoint is at the end. Every request reports zero cache reads. Why?

options.text: Timestamps are not allowed in cached prompts.
The cache matches on the exact prefix, so content that changes on every request before the breakpoint changes the prefix hash and prevents a hit.
The cache only works for the first request in a conversation.
The system prompt is too long to be cached.

explanation: A cache entry is keyed by a hash of the whole prefix up to the breakpoint, so a per-request value before it makes every prefix different. Keep stable content first and put varying content (timestamps, per-request context) after the cached part.
